correctness.rationale: For a general plane quartic, the canonical theta-characteristic dictionary represents 28 odd bitangents as q=1 vectors in F_2^6; six contact divisors lie on a cubic precisely if their vectors XOR to zero, via the restriction of cubic forms to C. Syzygetic triads are detected by q(u+v+w)=1. This is an EXACT finite model: independently enumerating all 376,740 unordered six-subsets produced 6048 zero-sum hexads and the class counts 1008/5040; all 20,475 tetrads gave profiles (0,0) 315, (3,3) 5040, (0,4) 15120; independent exact adjacency produced a connected 6048-vertex, 45360-edge graph, cross degrees 45/9, and representative pair intersections agreed. The inspected repository checker additionally exhausts ALL 6048x6048 pairs and asserts all table rows, rather than sampling. The finite exhaustive computation proves the finite combinatorial claim conditional on the standard theta-characteristic geometry; not a proof of that classical dictionary itself.
